accountingScope: Array/container allocated sizes are sys.getsizeof; dictionary key/value footprints count references and may count shared objects repeatedly. Lists count their reference storage only; referenced strings/ET trees are not deep-counted. This is an owner census, not exhaustive unique allocation tracking or RSS decomposition. Introspection time/memory is included in this diagnostic and not in earlier complete-phase measurements.

profile.borderPolicy: Qualified static permissions only. Explicit source uncertainty is reported without changing v3 access. No queues, delays, documents or real crossing-eligibility claim.

sampling.scope: Periodic samples can miss brief composition peaks. Field maxima are not simultaneous and must not be summed. memory.peak is a separate cumulative kernel counter; host/VM paging is unmeasured.

scope: Diagnostic final base only, using the accepted via-way omission set. Does not include original road-key retention, six fallback builds, barrier preparation, maneuver graph, exports or qualification. Never substitute this peak for a complete-phase admission measurement.
